stem: Five workers earn an average of ₱600 a day. One worker, who earns ₱800 a day, resigns. What is the average daily pay of the 4 workers who remain?
hints: Start from the total daily pay of all 5 workers.
Old total = ₱600 × 5. Then take away the ₱800 of the worker who left.
The 4 remaining workers earn ₱3,000 − ₱800 in all. Divide that by 4.

solution.methodName: Compare totals before and after the change

steps.why: By hand, divide by 4 by halving twice: ₱2,200 ÷ 2 = ₱1,100, then ₱1,100 ÷ 2 = ₱550.

steps.action: The average daily pay of the 4 workers is ₱550.

trapNotes.₱440: This is ₱2,200 ÷ 5. Only 4 workers remain, so divide by 4.
trapNotes.₱400: This takes the whole ₱200 difference (₱800 − ₱600) off the average. That ₱200 is shared by the 4 who remain, so the average drops by only ₱200 ÷ 4 = ₱50.
trapNotes.₱2,200: This is the total pay of the 4 workers who remain. Divide it by 4 to get the average.
